fields.options: Configure the default Job Applicant profile setup that every new Job Opening inherits. Admins can override these per-opening on the Job Opening's Job application tab. This is a curated list — internal-process fields (the Job Applicant Feedback tab: PIP, induction/onboarding feedback, goals) are intentionally excluded. New Job Applicant fields are not added automatically; add the ones you want with Add Row.

Education Stages a candidate must supply in the Educational Qualification table, per channel. The application-fields API returns these as stage_requirement.required_stages so the candidate form can enforce them (e.g. require 10th, 12th and Graduation on Campus). Leave empty to require no specific stage.

fields.label: Synced field refs (internal)
fields.description: Newline-separated list of Job Applicant field refs already seen by the reconcile (imported, deleted, or deliberately kept out). Anything in this list is never auto-added — this is what keeps manual deletes sticky and stops the curated list from being flooded by the rest of the doctype.
